sequential.protocol: Same process, clean model load per route; identical frozen checkpoint, CPU4/RPU8; 2 warmups + 5 measured. Full API timings include lightweight stage hooks.

interleaved.protocol: One public ASR model; same CPU convolution and text weights; two independently installed audio handles from the same clean CPU weights. Alternating routes, 2 warmup+5 measured each. Before each request, clear outgoing audio Graph and build/replay incoming audio outside timer to keep the default 4-arena bound. Full API timed with fresh convolution and normal text Graph replay; auxiliary audio preparation is explicitly excluded.
